$comment: Accepted plugins: the listings. What is served for each (the version records and bundles the pipeline builds) is under registry/v1, and an instance installs a release with voidbase plugins add <name>. A listed plugin without a release there is a registration.

entries.title: Backups
entries.summary: PocketBase's backups API: create, list, download, upload and restore archives kept in the instance's own R2 bucket.

entries.title: Hardening
entries.summary: PocketBase's rate limit rules and the 32 MB body limit, met by every request before a route. Provides hardening@1.

entries.title: Realtime
entries.summary: Realtime subscriptions over SSE, fanned out by the instance's hub Durable Object, with presence. Provides realtime@1.
